description: Comprehensive DTO Contract Catalog for the GULA Platform. Lists every Pydantic schema across all domains with field-level metadata, type classification, constraints, and route bindings.

auth.description: Authentication & registration schemas for all actor types (lab staff, citizens, doctors, mobile devices).

LoginRequest.description: Authentication payload — email + password login for staff and citizens.

RefreshRequest.description: Refresh token exchange — used by mobile and web to obtain new access tokens without re-authentication.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.description: Refresh token from prior login session; may also be read from httpOnly cookie

ChangePasswordRequest.description: Authenticated password change — requires current password verification.

LabRegisterRequest.description: Lab registration — creates a new lab (inactive) with its admin account pending platform approval.

CitizenRegisterRequest.description: Citizen self-registration — creates a citizen User + canonical MPI Citizen record.

fields.name: birth_date
fields.description: Date of birth in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD)

StaffRegisterRequest.description: Lab staff registration — lab admin adds a technician, doctor, receptionist, or generic staff.

DoctorRegisterRequest.description: Doctor self-registration — independent doctors register publicly; account is active but unverified until approved.

DeviceTokenRequest.description: Mobile device registration for push notifications (FCM/APNS).

fields.name: device_token
fields.description: Push notification token from Firebase Cloud Messaging or Apple Push Notification service

fields.name: app_version
fields.description: Version of the mobile application installed

CitizenLoginRequest.description: Citizen portal login — accepts email or phone as identifier.

fields.name: identifier
fields.description: Email or phone used as login credential

NationalIdRequest.description: National ID verification request — validates an Iraqi national ID against the national registry.

CreateLabRequest.description: Admin-only lab creation — creates a lab + admin user in a single operation.

CreateUserRequest.description: Admin-only user creation — creates a user with hierarchy-enforced role assignment.

ChangeRoleRequest.description: Role change request — admin reassigns a user's role with hierarchy enforcement.

_KillSwitchRequest.description: Kill-switch activation/deactivation payload (internal usage, master_admin only).

LinkIdentityRequest.description: Link a national ID to an existing patient record within a lab.

patients.description: Patient management schemas — CRUD operations for patient records within a lab.

PatientCreate.description: Create a new patient record — supports guardianship, family linkage, and optional duplicate bypass.

fields.name: birth_date
fields.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format

fields.name: family_id
fields.description: Civil registry family number (hashed before storage)

PatientUpdate.description: Partial patient record update — only provided fields are modified.

ScanRequest.description: Patient card QR scan token — resolves an HMAC-signed token to a patient record.

fields.name: token
fields.description: HMAC-signed card token from QR code

labs.description: Lab management schemas — lab profile updates and employee lifecycle management.

LabUpdate.description: Partial update of lab profile fields — only non-null fields are applied.

CreateEmployeeRequest.description: Add a new employee to the current lab — admin role required.

UpdateEmployeeRequest.description: Partial employee update — toggle active status or change role.

orders_results.description: Lab order and result management schemas — order creation, batch operations, device integration, and clinical interpretation.

ResultItem.description: Single test result entry within an order — supports numeric and textual values with reference ranges.

CreateOrderRequest.description: Create a new lab order with associated test results — links to patient and optional referring doctor.

fields.name: doctor_user_id
fields.description: Registered doctor user ID for data isolation

fields.name: results
fields.description: List of test results belonging to this order

AnalyzeRequest.description: Clinical analysis request — runs interpretation and critical-value checks on a set of results without persisting.

fields.name: results
fields.description: List of ResultItem entries to analyze

BatchResultItem.description: Single test result entry within a batch order — same structure as ResultItem.

BatchOrderItem.description: Single order within a batch — pairs a patient with results.

BatchOrderRequest.description: Batch order creation — creates up to 50 orders in a single transaction.

TestResultCreate.description: Citizen-centric single result creation — accepts health_id and attaches to an existing or new order.

fields.name: test_code
fields.description: Canonical test code from reference catalog

fields.name: order_id
fields.description: Attach to existing order; creates new one if omitted

TestResultRead.description: Full server-side representation of a test result — used by staff and API consumers.

TestResultBrief.description: Compact result view for list endpoints and search results — strip administrative fields.

TestResultForCitizen.description: Citizen-facing result view with Arabic serialization aliases — no technical/administrative fields.

TestResultValidateRequest.description: Pre-save validation request for a single test result — returns warnings without persisting.

DeviceResult.description: Single result received from a lab analyzer device — mirrors ResultItem structure.

DeviceSubmission.description: Device result submission — matches results to an order via sample barcode.

SuggestRequest.description: AI suggestion request — operations like interpretation suggestions for lab results.

RejectRequest.description: AI suggestion rejection — reason provided by the human reviewer.

ChatRequest.description: GULA AI assistant chat message (powered by Gemini 2.0 Flash).

fields.name: message
fields.description: User message to the AI assistant

fields.name: context
fields.description: Optional page context for contextual responses

samples.description: Sample collection and tracking schemas — specimen lifecycle from collection through analysis.

SampleCreate.description: Register a new specimen sample linked to an existing lab order.

fields.name: sample_type
fields.description: Type of specimen (blood, urine, stool, swab, serum, plasma, etc.)

fields.name: collected_by
fields.description: Name or ID of collector (defaults to current user)

SampleUpdate.description: Update sample status and metadata — tracks workflow progression and rejection handling.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Sample status (collected, received, processing, analyzed, rejected)

consent.description: Healthcare consent management schemas — grant/revoke/check time-bounded data access authorization.

GrantRequest.description: Grant time-bounded consent — authorizes a grantee to access the subject's data for a specific scope.

GrantResponse.description: Confirmation of a granted consent with expiry information.

RevokeRequest.description: Revoke an active consent — terminates authorization (subject or admin only).

RevokeResponse.description: Confirmation that consent was successfully revoked.

fields.name: revoked
fields.description: True if consent was successfully revoked

CheckResponse.description: Consent check result — indicates whether the requesting actor holds active consent.

fields.name: allowed
fields.description: Whether consent is active for this actor

claims.description: Insurance claims management schemas — claim creation, validation, and submission lifecycle.

ClaimItemCreate.description: Individual line item within an insurance claim.

ClaimCreate.description: Create a new insurance claim in draft status.

ClaimItemResponse.description: Line item representation returned in claim responses.

ClaimResponse.description: Full claim representation including nested line items.

edge.description: Edge Computing Platform schemas — device registration, task scheduling, policy management, and agent communication for off-premise lab instruments.

RegisterDeviceRequest.description: Register a new edge device (personal/clinic/enterprise) with its public key and capabilities.

fields.name: public_key_pem
fields.description: Device public key in PEM format

fields.name: capabilities
fields.description: Device capability map (CPU, RAM, GPU, etc.)

RegisterDeviceResponse.description: Device registration confirmation with agent token and trust score.

fields.name: agent_token
fields.description: Bearer token for agent API endpoints

DeviceSummary.description: Compact device summary for fleet listings.

DeviceDetail.description: Full device detail including capabilities, telemetry, and operational state.

TaskSubmitRequest.description: Submit a computational task for execution on edge devices.

TaskSummary.description: Compact task summary for list views.

TaskDetail.description: Full task detail including payload, result, and error information.

PolicyView.description: Effective edge policy for a lab — resource limits, trust thresholds, and allow/deny lists.

PolicyUpdate.description: Partial edge policy update — only provided fields are modified.

HeartbeatRequest.description: Agent heartbeat — periodic device status report and task claim.

fields.name: completed_task_uids
fields.description: List of recently completed task UIDs for ack/cleanup

HeartbeatResponse.description: Heartbeat acknowledgment with next task assignment and device state directives.

TaskResultRequest.description: Agent reports task execution result back to the control plane.

ModelRegisterRequest.description: Register a new AI/ML model for edge deployment.

ModelStatusUpdate.description: Update model lifecycle status and rollout percentage.

ModelAssignRequest.description: Assign a model to a specific lab or device for deployment.

mpi.description: Master Patient Index (MPI) schemas — identity resolution, deduplication, merging, and pending review workflow.

ResolveRequest.description: Resolve a local lab patient identity to a canonical MPI citizen — supports NID exact match and probabilistic matching.

ResolveResponse.description: MPI resolution result — matched citizen ULID with match method and confidence score.

fields.name: created
fields.description: Whether a new citizen record was created

CitizenResponse.description: Canonical citizen summary — deliberately excludes PII (name, phone, NID hash, family_id).

fields.name: nid_verified
fields.description: Whether NID has been verified against national registry

MergeRequest.description: Merge two citizen records — secondary into primary, with reason.

MergeResponse.description: Merge result with audit event chain information.

PendingReviewItem.description: An ambiguous identity claim awaiting admin adjudication.

PendingReviewPage.description: Paginated list of pending MPI review items.

ResolveDecision.description: Admin decision on an ambiguous identity claim — confirm match or reject and mint new citizen.

ai_telemetry.description: AI interaction telemetry and feedback schemas — RAG audit trails, user feedback, and unresolved question tracking per Directive §8/§14.

RetrievalRefIn.description: A single retrieval reference for RAG audit trails — tracks which documents were used to generate a response.

fields.name: doc_id
fields.description: Document ID in the source system

InteractionIn.description: Log a single user-AI interaction with full safety, retrieval, and hallucination-control metadata.

fields.name: prompt_redacted
fields.description: Whether prompt was redacted for PII

InteractionOut.description: Acknowledgement of a logged AI interaction.

FeedbackIn.description: Explicit user feedback on an AI interaction — signal + optional notes.

fields.name: signal
fields.description: Feedback signal (helpful, not_helpful, unclear, need_doctor, incorrect_interpretation)

UnresolvedIn.description: Flag a question the AI could not answer — captures gaps for dataset improvement.

governance.description: National Health Governance schemas — hierarchy management, delegations, acting appointments, workforce registry, and lab governance.

NodeCreate.description: Create a governance hierarchy node (governorate, directorate, province, etc.).

DelegationCreate.description: Delegate authority from one governance node to another with optional scope restrictions.

ActingAppoint.description: Appoint an acting authority node to temporarily exercise powers of another node.

WorkerCreate.description: Register a healthcare worker in the national workforce registry.

LabRegister.description: Register a laboratory in the national lab governance registry.

lims.description: National LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System) schemas — specimen tracking, order management, QC, instruments, inventory, and reports.

SpecimenRegisterRequest.description: Register a new specimen with barcode and container metadata.

SpecimenTransitionRequest.description: Transition a specimen to a new workflow status with optional rejection reason.

OrderCreateRequest.description: Create a LIMS order with accession number, priority, and clinical details.

fields.name: order_id
fields.description: Existing lab order ID to link

ResultCreateRequest.description: Create a single test result within a LIMS order — links to specimen and instrument.

ResultValidateRequest.description: Validate, reject, or flag a result — supports digital signature hash for audit trail.

IQCRunRequest.description: Record an internal quality control run with measured vs expected values.

InstrumentCreateRequest.description: Register a lab instrument/analyzer in the LIMS.

MaintenanceRecordRequest.description: Log a maintenance event for a lab instrument.

CalibrationRecordRequest.description: Log a calibration event for a lab instrument.

InventoryRequest.description: Register or update a consumable/reagent inventory item.

ReportGenerateRequest.description: Generate a lab report for an order in the specified locale.

DeviceMessageRequest.description: Submit a raw device message (ASTM/HL7) for parsing and processing.

fields.name: raw_message
fields.description: Raw ASTM or HL7 message text

ASTMResultResponse.description: Parsed ASTM result entry — used in device message responses.

subscription.description: Subscription tier management schemas — upgrade requests, demand signals, tier assignment, and feature flag overrides.

UpgradeRequestBody.description: Lab admin requests a subscription tier upgrade with optional deployment and security preferences.

DemandSignalBody.description: Citizen signals demand for a lab to upgrade its subscription tier.

SetTierBody.description: Platform admin manually sets a lab's subscription tier and configuration.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Admin notes about the tier assignment

FeatureFlagBody.description: Platform admin sets or removes a per-lab feature flag override with optional expiry.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.description: ISO datetime for automatic flag expiry

tasks.description: Background task queue schemas — shared data contracts between producers and consumers for the event outbox / task worker system.

TaskPayload.description: Internal task message payload with retry and timeout controls — used by the background worker queue.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Task type discriminator for worker routing

TaskResult.description: Result of a background task execution — status, output data, error info, and timing.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Task completion status (pending, running, done, failed, dead)

fields.name: attempt
fields.description: Which attempt this result corresponds to

TaskStatus.description: Task status enum — used across the task queue system for state management.

fields.name: value
fields.description: One of: pending, running, done, failed, dead

notifications.description: Notification delivery schemas — WhatsApp and SMS result notification dispatch.

NotifyRequest.description: Send a result notification to a patient via the specified channel.

fields.name: order_id
fields.description: Lab order ID whose results to share

quality_control.description: Quality Control schemas — Westgard rule evaluation for lab instrument validation.

QCSubmit.description: Submit a single quality control measurement for Westgard rule evaluation.

QCBatchSubmit.description: Submit multiple quality control measurements in a single request.

test_result_legacy.description: Legacy TestResult model schemas — used by the full TestResultCreate/Read/Brief/ForCitizen family backed by the test_results table.

TestResultCreate.description: Create a new TestResult record — citizen-centric, links to canonical citizen via MPI.
